goal: Replace the oversized stacked mobile Game Total Page 1 card composition with a compact three-metric decision card while preserving Kyre Sports API-only data ownership and Page 2 routing.
root_cause: The existing mobile CSS makes the Market Total cell span both columns, then renders Over/Under on a second row and No-Vig alone on a third row, producing excessive vertical space and an empty grid hole at 390px widths.
